product_metadata.title: Trgowaul 75th Birthday Backdrop Gold and Black 5.9 X 3.6 Fts Happy Birthday Party Decorations Banner for Women Men Photography Supplies Background Happy Birthday Decoration
features: [Supper Value Size] - The 75th birthday banner is 5.9ft(width)x3.6ft(heigth) / 70.8 x 43.3 inches. It is large enough for your birthday party. This banner will heighten the excitement of the 75th birthday party. The golden is not really a golden light, just the effect of a golden flash of the backdrop.

[Perfect Decoration] - Its size and pattern are very suitable for birthday cake background and photographic background. It is high quality, seamless, durable, lightweight, non-fading and easy to carry. The pattern is digitally printed with high quality and high resolution.
[Various Applications] - The black and gold birthday party backdrop is suitable for 75th birthday party banner decoration. It also can be used as wallpaper, curtain, backdrop for photo.

[Exquisite Design] -These vivid patterns were printed by high-quality digital resolution, such as the extra large gold balloons, stars, large 75 numbers and so on. It will make your birthday unforgettable.
[Easy to Use]- Trgowaul 75th birthday banner come with a roll of rope which allow you to pass the rope through the four corners of the banner. Then hang it on the tree, wall and anywhere you want.
